cuts.reason: Cuts from the wide two-shot of the couple in bed to a slightly punched-in reframe of the same pose right as the wife finishes her question, tightening on the husband's face for his reaction to the line.

Hard cuts from the husband's reaction beat straight to the black branded outro card ('LOW BATTERY PEOPLE / Created by Nin.'), ending the skit immediately after the punchline lands rather than lingering.

reaction_shots.description: Tighter reframe on the husband, still scrolling his phone, as his eyes widen and mouth drops open in reaction to his wife's line -- a reaction beat rather than new plot action.

pacing_notes: The whole skit is essentially two static shots of the couple in bed plus a title card: shot 1 runs long (~10.1s) to let the word-by-word caption dialogue play out and set up the joke, shot 2 tightens and shortens (~4.2s) to hold on the husband's reaction to the punchline, and the final outro card is the shortest (~2.0s), landing as a quick branded stamp right after the laugh. Overall pacing compresses from a slow, held setup shot to a snappier reaction and an abrupt sign-off, with almost no camera movement -- the pacing is carried by the captions and dialogue timing rather than by cutting frequency.
